lines: "Where do I exist right now?"
I keep looking back, again and again, at the footprints I pressed into the ground
Holding dead leaves, at the window turning to autumn
With numb fingertips, I traced my dreams
I have wings, yet I cannot fly
Being alone frightens me, and it hurts
The days I leaned my shoulder against that warm, sunlit spot
We move past them, walking toward our lonely dreams
Goodbye is not a sad word
It's the YELL that ties us to each of our own dreams
Holding the days we spent together in my chest
I'll take flight, alone, into the sky of the future
Why do we grow impatient for answers
And search for ourselves in aimless darkness?
Even the tears of longing for someone
Even an honest smile — they're right here, and yet
Patching up "my true self" with someone else's lines
Escaping, losing my way
The strength to face my weakness as it is
We grasp it, and for the first time, run toward tomorrow
Each time we say goodbye to someone
Can we change again, grow stronger again?
Even if we take flight into different skies
This longing will never be severed — even now, it's in my chest
From the moment we realized there is no eternity
The day we laughed together (the day we sang together)
Deeply, strongly, it's carved into our chests
That's why you (that's why we)
No one else, no one at all (unbeaten by anyone)
Raising our voice, promised to live as "myself"
That's the promise we made
Alone (alone), one path (one path), we chose it
Goodbye is not a sad word
It's the YELL that ties us to each of our own dreams
Until the day we meet again, by fate
Our pride we won't forget — friends — to the sky
There are words we share between us
From heart to heart, the YELL that joins our voices
Holding the days we spent together in my chest
I'll take flight, alone, into the sky of the future
